primaryMetaphor: Mechanical clock mechanism with timing wheels replacing chaotic binary heap operations
visualContinuity: Timing wheel mechanism that evolves from hidden background element to hero solution to hierarchical system

scenes.name: Challenge Introduction

keySync.visualEvent: Challenge box materializes with cyan glow and impact animation

scenes.visual: [3D REQUIRED] Bold 'SYSTEM DESIGN CHALLENGE' box materializes center screen with cyan neon border glow. Background shows abstract network nodes connected by flowing particle streams. Subtle gear mechanics rotate in deep background. Challenge box scales from 0% to 60% width with elastic bounce at sync point.
scenes.connectsTo: Network particles flow toward split screen formation
scenes.physics: Particle system with matter.js for flowing network data

scenes.name: The Obvious Solution

keySync.visualEvent: Binary heap structure assembles with animated node connections

scenes.visual: Split screen emerges - left shows millions of task orbs (glowing cyan spheres) flowing into system, right displays binary heap tree structure with animated rebalancing operations. Task counter shows increasing numbers. Heap nodes pulse during sort operations with purple connections.
scenes.buildsFrom: Network particles reorganize into split screen layout
scenes.connectsTo: Heap structure begins showing stress indicators
scenes.physics: Task orbs with realistic gravity and collision detection

scenes.name: The Trap Revealed

keySync.visualEvent: Scene dramatically shifts, heap shows strain with red warning indicators

scenes.visual: [ICON: warning] Binary heap structure starts showing stress - gears grind, sorting operations become chaotic with red warning flashes. Performance graph appears showing logarithmic complexity curve ascending sharply. Bottleneck visualization with task orbs backing up and system strain indicators.
scenes.emotion: Growing concern and realization of problem
scenes.buildsFrom: Heap structure from previous scene shows increasing strain
scenes.connectsTo: Chaotic system dissolves to make way for solution
scenes.physics: Grinding gears with vibration effects and particle overflow

scenes.name: Solution Emergence

keySync.visualEvent: Smooth timing wheel emerges from center with triumphant glow

scenes.visual: [3D REQUIRED] [ICON: checkmark] Chaotic heap dissolves with particle explosion. Clean, elegant timing wheel materializes from center with smooth cyan glow. Immediate sense of mechanical precision and elegance. Wheel rotates smoothly with 60 visible slots around perimeter.
scenes.emotion: Relief and elegance of simple solution
scenes.buildsFrom: Replaces chaotic heap with smooth mechanism
scenes.connectsTo: Timing wheel expands into detailed clock face
scenes.physics: Smooth wheel rotation with momentum conservation

scenes.name: Clock Face Visualization

keySync.visualEvent: Clock face assembles piece by piece with 60 slots appearing

scenes.visual: [3D REQUIRED] Detailed clock face assembly - 60 numbered slots appear around perimeter. Task orbs drop directly into specific time buckets without any sorting operations. Clear O(1) insertion demonstration with smooth particle physics. Clock hands indicate current time position.
scenes.buildsFrom: Timing wheel expands and details become visible
scenes.connectsTo: Single wheel reveals its limitation for long durations
scenes.physics: Precise orb placement with satisfying slot insertion

scenes.name: Hierarchical Genius

keySync.visualEvent: Second larger wheel slides into view like minute hand revelation

scenes.visual: [3D REQUIRED] Larger outer wheel slides into view acting as minute hand. Demonstrates cascade mechanism - when minute hand ticks, tasks flow from outer bucket down to inner wheel slots. Multiple timing levels working in perfect mechanical harmony. No sorting, just smooth rotation and gravity-fed cascading.
scenes.buildsFrom: Single wheel expands into multi-level system
scenes.connectsTo: Mechanical system validates with real-world examples

scenes.name: Real Implementation

keySync.visualEvent: Apache Kafka and Netty logos appear with validation graphics

scenes.visual: Scene transitions to real-world validation. Apache Kafka and Netty logos appear with their timing wheel architectures. Performance benchmarks show massive throughput capabilities compared to heap-based systems. Split comparison showing traditional vs timing wheel throughput metrics.
scenes.buildsFrom: Mechanical system proven in production environments
scenes.connectsTo: Technical credibility leads to personal branding
scenes.physics: Chart animations with smooth data visualization

scenes.name: Call to Action

keySync.visualEvent: Follow button pulses with engagement animation

scenes.visual: [ICON: play] Personal branding moment with Prasanna introduction. Animated follow button with pulsing effect. Pinned comment callout with pointer animation. Zoho logo integration. Social engagement elements with particle celebration effects.
scenes.buildsFrom: Technical expertise established, now building personal brand
scenes.physics: Celebration particles with gentle floating motion
